title: Minimal checked delivery — evaluate acceptance on run
goal: Turn 'Acceptance: not evaluated' into a real, honest evaluation: criteria checked by executable evidence, report claims tied to it.
scope: ymp run --check '<command>': after invocation termination, run the check command in the workspace; exit 0 = satisfied, nonzero = failed; recorded as evidence with the command line and exit code.
Port the proven check mechanics from the prior implementation (command execution, exact-bytes and file-snapshot evidence with SHA-256) adapting names to the canonical vocabulary; no legacy terms.
Report states per criterion: satisfied with evidence / failed with evidence / unevaluated with reason; nothing else.
Persist the evaluation in the journal (additive event); ymp show prints it.
acceptance: Unattended tests: satisfied, failed, unevaluated paths; evaluation survives restart via show; check command cannot mutate the journal (read-only or separate context).
A real run with --check 'echo ok' reports satisfied with evidence.
context: Mechanical parts ported from the prior implementation per owner directive; unique logic is the evaluation wiring into observations/journal/report.

history.note: Implemented checked run evaluation, durable criterion evidence, protected command execution, persisted show output, and unattended coverage; independent review accepted commit d9e27d6.
